major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast Halo at the front of every cooldown window so its Power Surge pulses are already ramping when Voidform lands.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 120644 is the Shadow Halo cast observed in all five parses; the other ids sharing the Halo name are Holy versions or auras (453094 is the self aura).

major_cooldowns.name: Voidform
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter Voidform once Shadow Word: Pain and Vampiric Touch are out, then spend every Void Volley before it ends.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 228260 is the cast id seen in parses; 194249 is the Voidform buff the log carries and is what buff conditions use.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press Power Infusion as soon as Voidform is up, and keep your own uses ahead of an ally's when the two clash.

major_cooldowns.name: Void Torrent
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Voidweaver, cast Void Torrent once your dots are out and follow it with Void Blast while the Entropic Rift is open.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 263165 is castable per its tooltip but was not pressed in the sampled parses, which all played Archon.

defensives.name: Dispersion
defensives.usage_rule: Save Dispersion for a hit you cannot avoid, and accept that you cast nothing for its 6 seconds.

defensives.name: Desperate Prayer
defensives.usage_rule: Press Desperate Prayer as you drop toward 75% health so the bonus maximum health soaks the next hit.

defensives.name: Vampiric Embrace
defensives.usage_rule: Line Vampiric Embrace up with your own burst so the raid gets healing while your single-target damage is highest.

rules.description: Open Shadow Word: Pain, Halo, Voidform, Power Infusion
rules.action: Land your dots first, then Halo, Voidform and Power Infusion before you settle into filler.
Press Power Infusion on the next global after Voidform instead of banking it for an ally.

rules.description: Keep Shadow Word: Madness on your target
rules.action: Spend insanity on Shadow Word: Madness before its dot expires instead of sitting on it.

rules.description: Keep Vampiric Touch on your targets
rules.action: Refresh Vampiric Touch with Tentacle Slam, and hard cast it when Tentacle Slam is not ready.

rules.description: Keep Shadow Word: Pain on your targets
rules.action: Recast Shadow Word: Pain as soon as it drops, and use it as your filler while you move.

rules.description: Void Volley is your filler inside Voidform
rules.action: Fit every Void Volley into Voidform instead of channelling Mind Flay.

rules.description: Mind Flay: Insanity replaces Mind Flay on proc
rules.action: Spend the proc on its own channel rather than starting a plain Mind Flay.
